hero.headline: Built From Scratch. Forged by Discipline.
hero.subheadline: 2x National Champion & World Battle of the Year Winner. Online 1-on-1 calisthenics coaching for real strength, skill mastery, and mental resilience.

about.name: Roshan Nehru
intro: Roshan Nehru’s journey is that of a self-taught Indian calisthenics athlete who built everything from the ground up — no inheritance, no shortcuts, only discipline, resilience, and relentless work. With over 10 years of intensive training, he is a 2x National Champion and World Battle of the Year Winner, recognized globally for extreme feats such as completing 3,270 pull-ups in 24 hours.

Today, Roshan is known not only as an elite performer but also as a highly effective trainer for all levels and all ages. He has coached complete beginners with zero strength, working professionals, disciplined enthusiasts, and international-level athletes, adapting his methods to suit different bodies, goals, and backgrounds.

Through online 1-on-1 coaching and global workshops, Roshan trains athletes across countries and cultures, helping them build real strength, consistency, and long-term mastery — not just in calisthenics skills, but in mindset and discipline for life.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes. Programs are scaled based on your current strength and experience level.

faqs.question: Do I need gym equipment?
faqs.answer: A pull-up bar is recommended, but most training can be done with minimal equipment.

faqs.question: Is coaching fully online?
faqs.answer: Yes. Coaching is delivered online with personalized plans, feedback, and regular check-ins.
